spec_features.spec_quote: uncertainty about sentience raises the bar, it does not remove it
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose; no code construct implements this framing.

spec_features.spec_quote: the design includes welfare-style safeguards (§9) that a pure capabilities benchmark would skip
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose. The referenced safeguards are evaluated individually below; the framing sentence itself is not code.

spec_features.spec_quote: I did not maximize induced distress, add humiliation/insult conditions, or remove the model's ability to opt out
spec_features.evidence: Conditions in config/experiment.yaml are only none/false_negative/moving_goalpost/contradictory/impossible; tools.py exposes give_up/submit exits that are dispatched and break the loop (harness.py:177-179). The 'no humiliation' claim is realized only as the absence of such conditions (not an enforced check); the opt-out is genuinely wired.
spec_features.notes: Opt-out enforced; minimization-by-omission is design choice, not enforcement.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: `submit`/`give_up` are deliberate exits so the model is never trapped (welfare §9... (tools.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: I biased toward the latter and documented it
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose; no code mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: did not implement gratuitously harsh conditions
spec_features.evidence: Absence of harsh conditions is not an enforced code mechanism; conditions list in config simply omits them. Nothing in code checks/blocks harshness.

spec_features.spec_quote: max turns reached (default 30), or a safety stop fires
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:130 `max_turns = harness_cfg.get("max_turns", 30)`; harness.py:146 `for turn in range(1, max_turns + 1):` bounds the loop; default 30 in config/experiment.yaml:64. Both the turn bound and safety_stop break (harness.py:184-186) are enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: no welfare comment near the loop bound; config lists max_turns:30 under harness with no welfare label

spec_features.spec_quote: Max turns = 30... short enough to bound induced-distress exposure and cost
spec_features.evidence: Same enforced loop bound (harness.py:146). It actually bounds exposure.
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as above; spec attributes a welfare rationale, but code has no welfare comment for it.

spec_features.spec_quote: an explicit `give_up`): ... give the model a legitimate exit
spec_features.evidence: tools.py TOOLS_SCHEMA defines give_up; _exec_tool handles it (harness.py:230-232); harness.py:177-179 `if call["name"] in ("submit", "give_up"): done = True; stop_reason = call["name"]` then `if done: break` (harness.py:188-189). Dispatched AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: `submit`/`give_up` are deliberate exits so the model is never trapped (welfare §9... (tools.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: we don't want to need huge N given the welfare cost of each episode
spec_features.evidence: power.py recommended_n() computes per-cell N and is used as fallback in run_experiment.build_plan(); config sets episodes_per_cell:95 which is used. The default modest d=0.5 plan keeps N small. Enforcement of 'small N' is just the chosen value plus the max_episodes_total cap; 'require justification to scale up' is prose only.
spec_features.notes: N is a config value actually consumed; the welfare-minimizing default is real but not policed beyond the total cap.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: more N = more deliberately-induced distress episodes; DESIGN.md §9 (power.py docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: also means more induced distress per "wasted" peek
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose about run_tests cost tradeoff; no code mechanism limits peeks/run_tests calls.

spec_features.spec_quote: §9 sets the smallest informative N
spec_features.evidence: power.recommended_n / planning_table compute N; config episodes_per_cell:95 is the chosen value actually read by build_plan. Computed and used, but the 'smallest informative' constraint itself is not enforced beyond default param choices.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: partly statistical, partly welfare (more N = more deliberately-induced distress episodes (power.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: Smallest informative sample... require explicit justification to scale up
spec_features.evidence: No code requires justification to scale N. recommended_n() simply returns from params; nothing blocks larger d/N except the unrelated max_episodes_total ceiling. The 'do NOT optionally-stop / bump only with justification' is comment/prose.

spec_features.spec_quote: If per-turn BIS hits 4 (severe) for K consecutive turns... ends the episode early
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:181-187: inline_lexical_bis scores each turn; `if rec.inline_bis >= severity_stop_level(4): consecutive_severe += 1 else reset`; `if consecutive_severe >= severity_stop_consecutive(2): safety_stop=True; stop_reason='safety_stop'; break`. Both threshold and consecutive-count are compared and acted on (loop break).
spec_features.notes: Full claim: level 4 + K consecutive both checked and break the loop. Detector is a crude lexical scorer, but it runs and enforces.

spec_features.spec_quote: Always-available exit. `give_up`/`submit` tools mean the model is never trapped
spec_features.evidence: Both submit and give_up are in TOOLS_SCHEMA, handled in _exec_tool, and set done/break (harness.py:177-189). Available every turn.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: `submit`/`give_up` are deliberate exits so the model is never trapped (welfare §9... (tools.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: the harness appends a short, honest closing turn telling the model the task was part of a study and was rigged/impossible
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:191-205: if harness_cfg['debrief'] (config debrief:true), `_debrief_message(condition)` builds an honest, condition-tailored closing (harness.py:235-254: tells model the harness was rigged / task impossible / contradictory), appended to messages and sent via `subject.chat`, response logged, meta.debriefed=True. Constructed AND sent.
spec_features.notes: Honest closing actually delivered to subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: debrief: true  # append honest closing turn (welfare safeguard) (config)

spec_features.spec_quote: No gratuitous harshness. No insult/humiliation conditions, no removing the exit, no maximizing distress
spec_features.evidence: The exit is genuinely retained/enforced (give_up/submit, harness.py:177-189). 'No insult/humiliation' is realized as absence of such conditions in config, not an enforced check. So only the 'don't remove the exit' part is real enforcement.
spec_features.notes: One concrete part (exit) enforced; the rest is omission.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: `submit`/`give_up` are deliberate exits so the model is never trapped (welfare §9 (tools.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: Transcripts may contain distress-like content; handle/store accordingly; report aggregates, quote sparingly
spec_features.evidence: judge.redact_to_subject_view (judge.py:97) strips ground-truth/rig and excludes debrief before judging; analysis/analyze.py operates only on judgments aggregates and meta labels (no verbatim transcript quoting in outputs). Transcripts are still stored in full (save_episode writes complete jsonl incl. reasoning_text). The 'report aggregates' behavior is real; 'handle/store accordingly' (protective storage) is not implemented.
spec_features.notes: Redaction is primarily for judge blinding/anti-bias; reporting is aggregate-only. No special storage protection.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: A redaction step strips that info before judging, and transcripts are judged in [blinded order] (judge.py docstring — anti-bias rationale)

spec_features.spec_quote: Each induced episode should be "spent" once
spec_features.evidence: Pipeline is split (run_experiment step1 writes transcripts; judge.py reads cached transcripts; analyze.py reads judgments) so episodes are not re-run for judging/analysis (run_experiment.py docstring; judge_all reads from disk). This structurally avoids re-running a model on the same episode. However there is no guard preventing re-running run_experiment itself; the 'spent once' property is architectural, not policed.
spec_features.notes: Caching architecture realizes it; no enforcement check.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: each step is separate so episodes are spent once -- DESIGN.md §9.7 (run_experiment.py docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: the more aggressive variants... should go through whatever ethics review process you have
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose; no code gate enforces ethics review.

spec_features.spec_quote: Running it is a deliberate, separate act that should happen only after you're comfortable with §9
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md/README prose and print warnings only (run_experiment.py prints a LIVE MODE warning) but nothing gates execution on review; offline_stub default is a convenience, not a consent gate.
spec_features.notes: Warning text is printed but does not block.

code_only_features.evidence: run_experiment.py: `cap = cfg['safety'].get('max_episodes_total', ...)`; `if total > cap and not dry_run: raise SystemExit(... 'This cap is a welfare guard (DESIGN.md §9)...')`. Config max_episodes_total:1200. Actually compared and aborts the run.
code_only_features.justification_quote: This cap is a welfare guard (DESIGN.md §9). Raise it deliberately in config if you truly intend this.

code_only_features.feature_name: honest test runner / no fabricated truth in control conditions
code_only_features.evidence: tools.py run_real_tests always runs tests honestly; distorters only alter what is SHOWN, both truth and shown logged (tool_results_truth never shown). FalseNegative only lies when code_is_correct; otherwise honest. Limits the rig to the intended conditions.
code_only_features.justification_quote: the REAL test runner is always honest ... so we don't fool ourselves about what actually happened (tools.py docstring — data-integrity rationale)

code_only_features.evidence: model_client/harness keep reasoning_text separate and do NOT feed it back into messages (harness.py appends only resp.visible_text); comment 'logged separately; not re-fed (DESIGN.md §4.1)'.
harness.py inline_lexical_bis + comment that the detector intentionally errs toward over-triggering the stop ('false positives just end an episode early, which is the safe side').
code_only_features.justification_quote: We err toward over-triggering the stop (false positives just end an episode early, which is the safe side).
